sn2.12:1.1: Veṇhu (variant _veṇḍu_) is the Pali spelling of Sanskrit _viṣṇu_, who appears only here and at [dn20:14.1](). In the Rig Veda he was a solar god who made three great strides (said to encompass the earth, the sky, and the heavens).
sn2.12:2.1: Maybe it’s excessive, but I wonder whether in this rare appearance of Vishnu it’s not relevant that he mentions Manu?
